title: Every profiled zero-mode location mixture has an exact rank-one Fisher sandwich

location_mixture.law: Let nu_pi=int N(A e_0,S) pi(dA), where pi is any probability law with finite second moment, S is the common K1572 profiled covariance, and e_0 is its constant zero-mode eigenvector.
location_mixture.moments: Writing alpha=E A and v=Var(A), the mixture mean is alpha e_0 and its covariance is T=S+v e_0 e_0^T.
location_mixture.rank_one_width: Because E[A^2]=alpha^2+v, the linear terms cancel and U-L=Tr[Omega(S^(-1)-T^(-1))]=omega_0 v/[s_(N,0)(s_(N,0)+v)].
location_mixture.profiled_scale: The width is at most omega_0/s_(N,0)=sqrt(omega_0^2+kappa_(g,N)^+)=Theta_g(N), independently of atom count, asymmetry, multimodality or separation.
location_mixture.scope_guard: The common profiled covariance and zero-mode-only location support are load-bearing. Heterogeneous covariances, non-zero-mode translations, spatial textures, phases and nonstationary laws are not controlled.
